name: badge
description: A short label on a filled ground, such as a status.

name: bleedImage
description: One image across the full width; an optional caption in the slot.

arguments.name: image
arguments.description: A file or file reference; a video as k:media gives it plays in place.

name: breadcrumb
description: The path to the page; the last item is the page itself and has no link.

arguments.name: items
arguments.description: Entries with title and link (a URL); the last is the current page.

name: button
description: The call to action of a section: a link with href, a button without.

arguments.name: href
arguments.description: Turns the button into a link.

arguments.name: variant
arguments.description: primary or secondary on the page ground, light or outline on photos.

name: chapter
description: A chapter of the journal: a large number, date, title, the text in the slot and its photos, which open in the lightbox.

arguments.name: id
arguments.description: Anchor, also ties the title to the chapter.

arguments.name: images
arguments.description: File references; their span (1 to 12) and shift set the layout.

name: chip
description: A filter link; the active one marks the current page.

name: cluster
description: Children in a row that wraps; the last one moves to the right end.

name: ctaCard
description: A call to action under a line: title, text and a link; the whole card is the target.

arguments.name: variant
arguments.description: default, or featured to draw the line in the accent.

name: downloadList
description: Files to download, each with type and size read from the file.

arguments.name: files
arguments.description: Files or file references; a reference title wins over the file name.

name: factList
description: Pairs of label and value under an optional heading.

name: faqItem
description: One question of a faqList; open shows its answer from the start.

arguments.name: open
arguments.description: Shows the answer from the start.

name: faqList
description: Questions and answers that open one at a time; the entries are faqItem components.

name: featureCard
description: A card that shows a place: image, title and text; featured sets it larger.

arguments.name: tall
arguments.description: A taller photo, as the card below a pair has.

name: figure
description: One image, or two side by side, with a caption in the slot; they open in the lightbox.

arguments.name: images
arguments.description: One or two files or file references; a video as k:media gives it plays in place.

arguments.name: ruled
arguments.description: Draws the line above the caption.

name: gallery
description: A grid of images that open in the lightbox; an optional caption in the slot.

arguments.name: images
arguments.description: Files or file references; a video as k:media gives it opens in the lightbox too.

arguments.name: skip
arguments.description: Leaves out the first images, for example one already shown above.

name: grid
description: Children in equal columns: 2, 3 or 4, fewer on narrow screens.

name: hero
description: The opening photo of a page: eyebrow and title, the teaser in the slot, buttons in the fragment actions, stat components in the fragment stats.

name: heroSplit
description: An opening in two halves: fill the fragments text and panel.

name: highlight
description: A statement with the theme emblem: eyebrow, title and the text in the slot.

name: icon
description: An icon of the theme set, drawn to the TYPO3 icon grid.

arguments.name: name
arguments.description: One of: clock, phone, mail, map-pin, home, file, search, chevron-down, alert, arrow-right, sun, close, play, download.

arguments.name: label
arguments.description: Accessible name; without it the icon is decorative.

name: iconButton
description: A round arrow button, as the slider uses.

name: iconFact
description: A fact with an icon in a circle: label, value and an optional note.

arguments.name: icon
arguments.description: Name of an icon, as for icon.

name: image
description: A responsive image: 1200px wide as src, 640, 1200 and 2400 in srcset.

arguments.name: sizes
arguments.description: How wide the image is shown, so the browser picks the smallest sharp file.

arguments.name: height
arguments.description: Height attribute; default the scaled height.

arguments.name: eager
arguments.description: Loads at once, for the first image of a page.

name: infoBox
description: A box with a title, the text in the slot and infoBoxLink components in the fragment links.

name: infoBoxLink
description: A link at the foot of an infoBox.

name: lightboxGroup
description: The images in it page through one lightbox; it loads the lightbox script.

name: lightboxLink
description: An image that opens large in the lightbox; place it inside a lightboxGroup. A video plays there.

arguments.name: image
arguments.description: A file or file reference, or a video as k:media gives it.

name: link
description: A text link in the accent with an arrow: forward by default, back with direction back.

name: linkTile
description: A large link with an icon in a circle and an arrow.

arguments.name: icon
arguments.description: Name of an icon, as for icon.

name: logoBird
description: The theme's emblem, the three-legged crow, as the highlight shows it.

name: mediaList
description: Rows with a small round image, a title and a meta line; the rows are mediaListItem components, a link to more in the fragment more.

name: mediaListItem
description: One row of a mediaList.

arguments.name: image
arguments.description: A file or file reference, shown round.

name: notice
description: A short warning with an icon; the title as an argument, the text in the slot. Its styles ship in global.css.

arguments.name: title
arguments.description: The title, set before the text.

name: pageHeader
description: The head of a content page: breadcrumb, title and chip components in the fragment chips.

arguments.name: breadcrumb
arguments.description: Entries for the breadcrumb, as there.

name: pageIntro
description: The opening of a journal page: eyebrow, title, the lede in the slot, a meta line and an optional upright name.

arguments.name: meta
arguments.description: A small line below the lede.

arguments.name: upright
arguments.description: A name set upright at the edge; decorative.

name: pagination
description: Numbered pages of a list; the entries are paginationItem components.

arguments.name: label
arguments.description: Name of the navigation, such as Pages.

name: paginationItem
description: A page number, an arrow to the previous or next page, or a gap: without href it renders as a gap.

arguments.name: label
arguments.description: The number, an arrow such as ← or →, or … for a gap.

arguments.name: href
arguments.description: The target; left out for a gap.

name: personCard
description: A person with a round photo, role and focus.

arguments.name: image
arguments.description: A file or file reference, shown round.

name: portraitCard
description: A tall card for a stage: image, label, figures, title and text.

arguments.name: href
arguments.description: Links the title; the whole card is then the target.

arguments.name: label
arguments.description: A label above, such as Day 2.

arguments.name: meta
arguments.description: Figures beside the label, such as the distance.

name: quote
description: A quotation set large; the quote in the slot, its source as an argument.

name: rail
description: Children in a row that scrolls sideways and snaps.

name: richText
description: Editorial HTML from the editor, in the slot: headings, paragraphs, lists and links.

name: routeMap
description: A schematic map of a route: a path, stations with names, day marks below and a legend. Stations and day marks with a link lead there; the stretch between the first and last highlighted station is drawn in accent.

arguments.name: label
arguments.description: Describes the map for screen readers.

arguments.name: path
arguments.description: SVG path data of the route in a 1000 × 250 box.

arguments.name: stations
arguments.description: Entries with x, y, name, label_y, anchor, boundary, highlight and link; the last is the end.

arguments.name: days
arguments.description: Entries with x, label and link, set below the map.

name: section
description: A band of the page: its ground and the space around it; the content goes in the slot.

arguments.name: space
arguments.description: Space above and below: default, large, flush-top or none.

arguments.name: bleed
arguments.description: Lets a rail run to the edge of the viewport.

arguments.name: label
arguments.description: Accessible name, when the section has no visible heading.

arguments.name: id
arguments.description: Anchor to link to the section.

name: sectionHeading
description: The heading of a section: an optional eyebrow above, an aside or the slider arrows beside it.

arguments.name: controls
arguments.description: Shows the previous and next arrows of a slider.

name: slider
description: Cards in a row that scrolls, with arrows beside the heading and dots below; the cards go in the slot.

arguments.name: title
arguments.description: The heading, also the name of the card row.

arguments.name: count
arguments.description: Number of cards, for the dots.

name: split
description: Two columns side by side, stacked on narrow screens: fill the fragments first and second.

arguments.name: ratio
arguments.description: content-sidebar, text-media, heading-content, wide-narrow, narrow-wide or even.

arguments.name: align
arguments.description: Vertical alignment: start, center or end.

name: stack
description: Children one below the other at a set gap.

arguments.name: gap
arguments.description: heading (heading to content), elements (between the elements of a section), column (in a column), or a spacing step such as 16 or 24.

name: stat
description: A figure with its label: large on the page ground, on-image over a photo.

name: statRow
description: Large figures side by side; the figures are stat components.

name: subNav
description: Navigation between sibling pages under a heading; the items are subNavItem components.

arguments.name: title
arguments.description: Heading, also the name of the navigation.

name: subNavItem
description: A link in a subNav; the current page is marked.

name: teaserCard
description: A card that links to a page: image, title, subtitle and a meta line with an optional badge.

arguments.name: title
arguments.description: The title, also the link text.

arguments.name: meta
arguments.description: A small line at the foot, such as a date.

arguments.name: badge
arguments.description: A short label beside the meta line.

name: textMedia
description: An image beside a heading, the text in the slot as paragraphs and an optional link.

arguments.name: image
arguments.description: A file or file reference; a video as k:media gives it plays in place.

name: timeline
description: An ordered list of timelineItem components.

name: timelineItem
description: One entry of a timeline: date, title, text and time.

arguments.name: date
arguments.description: Label above, such as Day 1 · 20 April.

arguments.name: time
arguments.description: A note below, such as a time span.

name: video
description: A video in an image's place: the poster in the video's format and a play button. The player (MP4, WebM, YouTube, Vimeo) waits in a template, whose content the browser does not fetch, until the button is pressed; YouTube and Vimeo ask first.

arguments.name: poster
arguments.description: An image file or reference shown until play.

arguments.name: width
arguments.description: The video's width, for its format.

arguments.name: height
arguments.description: The video's height, for its format.

arguments.name: class
arguments.description: A class for the box, where an element's layout hangs on it.

name: videoConsent
description: The question asked before a YouTube or Vimeo player loads, as that sends the visitor's address to the provider. It waits in a template for the play button; own video files need none and get nothing.
